_comment: DEV ONLY. External A2A agents PodOS connects to at seed time. Each runs as its own service; PodOS marks it available when its Agent Card answers (checked every 30s). Production: connect agents from Admin -> Registry -> Connect A2A agent instead.

agents.name: Institutional Entity Intelligence
agents.description: Answers questions about legal entities and institutions from public records: GLEIF identity and corporate hierarchy, SEC 13F reported holdings, 13D/G beneficial owners, N-PORT funds, Form ADV, FFIEC bank control and Companies House. Every figure is cited to a source record and the answer is independently verified.

agents.name: Sportscanner Court Finder
agents.description: Finds publicly bookable London sports courts by sport, location, date and time, with prices and booking links. Available only to Yasir Khalid; it never books or pays.
